topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can't believe it. Decades of memories, erased. It's like I don't matter, like my existence in his life was nothing. I've carried these moments with me, cherished them, built my understanding of who I am around them. And for him, they're just... gone? How are you supposed to deal with that? Every laugh, every fight, every stupid adventure—none of it means anything to him now. I feel like I'm standing at the edge of a cliff, looking down at a version of my past that he's somehow walked away from. It’s not fair. How do you bridge that gap, when one of you is living in the present and the other is still trapped in a past that doesn't exist for the other anymore?
